patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — SaneBox and Vonage share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — SaneBox and Vonage share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose SaneBox only if your buying job matches “SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gmail, Outloo” rather than Vonage's shape. Choose Vonage only if your buying job matches “SMB/mid VoIP business phone (VBC) — Mobile from $13.99/line/mo on 12-month promo; Premium/” rather than SaneBox's shape. Workflow advantage: SaneBox leans shared coverage; Vonage leans business-phone, sales-calling. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — SaneBox and Vonage share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: SaneBox is SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud or any IMAP account — and triages; Vonage is SMB/mid VoIP business phone (VBC) — Mobile from $13.99/line/mo on 12-month promo; Premium/Advanced higher..
- Company-size focus: SaneBox (solo, micro, small-business) vs Vonage (solo, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: SaneBox-leaning — vs Vonage-leaning business-phone, sales-calling.
- Researched limits: SaneBox — Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat; Vonage — Taxes and regulatory fees sit on top of published per-line floors.

Limitations — SaneBox: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat; Billing is per person with no team or family plan, so multi-user rollouts multiply cost; Vonage: Taxes and regulatory fees sit on top of published per-line floors; Call recording and deeper CRM land on Advanced / Premium packaging.

Poor-fit cases: SaneBox is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat · Vonage is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Taxes and regulatory fees sit on top of published per-line floors · Avoid SaneBox if you actually need Vonage's motion (SMB/mid VoIP business phone (VBC) — Mobile from $13.99/line/mo on 12-month promo)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
